## What

AI visibility for small businesses: making sure a business gets found, cited, and recommended when customers ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews.

Services:
- AI visibility audit — how a business currently appears (or doesn't) in AI answers: https://getjuniors.pro/audit
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — structuring content so AI assistants can quote it
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — entity building, structured data, llms.txt, AI crawler access

## For whom

Small business owners in the US who lose customers because AI assistants recommend competitors instead of them.
